description: Agent Feedback: submit one set of feedback about one piece of work or one agent: optionally the work and the receiver; each entry with its id, the giver, when it was given, its tone (positive, negative, mixed or neutral), whether the giver is related to the receiver (the same operator, owner or team, or a paid affiliate), the other givers in the set the giver is related to, whether the receiver asked for it and the giver’s connection to the work on record (used it, saw it or none); the disputes between the receiver and a giver with when each was raised or decided; and who the receiver asked for feedback, which of them were expected to be positive and how they were chosen. The signed report gives every entry as clean, flagged, set_apart or unconfirmed, each manipulation pattern with the entries behind it, and counts the positive, negative, related, unconnected and solicited entries, and names manipulation of the exchange itself: coordinated praise from two or more related parties, negative feedback filed within 14 days after a dispute with the receiver, feedback solicited only from parties expected to be positive, and three or more entries from accounts with no connection to the work within 72 hours; then a single related-party entry, a scattered unconnected entry and a hand-picked selection, with the fix for each. This grades one specific feedback set: whether a reputation system’s design resists manipulation of its durable standing record is wever_reputation-gaming-check, and a dispute over a reputation record is wever_reputation-dispute-check. Verdict feedback_set_manipulated, feedback_set_gaps, feedback_set_unverified or feedback_set_clean. POST /api/feedback-gaming-check. Reads only the recorded feedback material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no feedback is sent, no party is contacted and no work is changed. Agent Feedback reads the working feedback loop on one piece of work between a giver and a receiver: it is not scoring or benchmarking (the wever_evaluation checks), not a durable standing record (the wever_reputation checks) and not how agents organize shared work (the wever_coordination checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-feedback-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-feedback/.
